review_notes: I read the whole file. I looked for repeated nontrivial reasoning and compared candidate pairs. The `binEntropy_*` sign lemmas mostly reduce to each other through `binEntropy_one_sub`. `qaryEntropy_strictMonoOn` and `qaryEntropy_strictAntiOn` have a similar skeleton, but their inequality arguments differ enough that a shared lemma would gain little, so I did not report them. The strongest repetition is in the two `not_continuousAt_deriv_qaryEntropy_*` lemmas. I did not run Lean, so the proposed helper and the rewritten proofs are untested sketches. The `Ioo` membership side conditions in the one-sided neighbourhoods would need small adjustments.

findings.problem: The two lemmas repeat the same argument. (1) Both prove `fun p ↦ log (q - 1) + log (1 - p) - log p` equals `log (q - 1) + (log (1 - p) - log p)` by `ext; ring`, so that the private tendsto lemma applies. (2) Both then use `Tendsto.congr'` with `filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds…]` to replace the expression by `deriv (qaryEntropy q) p`. That step calls `deriv_qaryEntropy` and discharges `p ≠ 0` and `p ≠ 1` from `p ∈ Ioo _ _` with `simp_all only [mem_Ioo, ne_eq]` and `linarith`. (3) Both then call `not_continuousAt_of_tendsto … nhdsWithin_le_nhds` with a `disjoint_nhds_at…_iff` side goal. The proofs are about 16 lines each, differ only in the filter and the infinity direction, and are written in noticeably different styles. A change to `deriv_qaryEntropy`, or to the form of the `deriv` expression, has to be made twice.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a private lemma, placed after `deriv_qaryEntropy`, that exposes the derivative in the `c + (log (1 - p) - log p)` form on the open interval:

`private lemma deriv_qaryEntropy_eq_add_of_mem_Ioo (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : deriv (qaryEntropy q) p = log (q - 1) + (log (1 - p) - log p)`

Proof sketch: obtain `p ≠ 0` and `p ≠ 1` from `hp.1` and `hp.2` (`hp.1.ne'`, `hp.2.ne`). Then `rw [deriv_qaryEntropy h0 h1]; ring`.

Each non-continuity lemma then becomes: take `tendsto_atBot_add_const_left` (or `tendsto_atTop_add_const_left`) applied to the existing private `tendsto_log_one_sub_sub_log_nhds…` lemma, to get `Tendsto (fun p ↦ log (q - 1) + (log (1 - p) - log p)) (𝓝[<] 1) atBot`. Apply `.congr'` with `filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show (1 : ℝ) - 2⁻¹ < 1 by simp)] with p hp using (deriv_qaryEntropy_eq_add_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [hp.1], hp.2⟩).symm`. Finish with `not_continuousAt_of_tendsto this nhdsWithin_le_nhds (by simp)`. The `zero` lemma is analogous with `𝓝[>] 0`, `Ioo_mem_nhdsGT`, and the `⟨hp.1, by linarith [hp.2]⟩` membership proof. The `ext; ring` rewriting and the `p ≠ 0 / p ≠ 1` discharge then appear once.
findings.benefit: The `ring` rewrite and the `Ioo` side-condition reasoning for the deriv formula are stated once. The two lemmas shrink to a short, parallel tendsto, congruence and non-continuity pattern. Readers can see directly that the cases are mirror images, and future changes to `deriv_qaryEntropy` need only one edit.
